title: Correctable Feature Registry Entry
description: A single entry in core.config__correctable_feature. Describes one correctable feature slice (state × year × feature): its display info, binding column, and the set of logical fields that can be corrected via FYOD or Data Studio. Deliberately unversioned — edits take effect in place.

state.description: Two-letter US state code (FIPS/postal). Part of the natural key (state × year × feature).

year.description: Four-digit data vintage year. Part of the natural key.

feature.description: Logical feature identifier. The table-name generator resolves this to the physical feature table, so entries survive table renames. Part of the natural key.

stable_key_col.description: The physical column that holds the feature's stable_key — the content-derived, reload-stable identity used to bind corrections. Never the surrogate row id.

type_col.description: Discriminator column for multitype feature tables (e.g. a table that holds both schools and daycares distinguished by a 'type' column). Null for single-type features.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for this feature, shown in the correction editor and management UI.

description.description: Optional notes about what this feature contains, its data source, or caveats for correctors.
examples: GTFS-sourced transit stops. Route-level corrections only — do not modify stop coordinates without verifying the GTFS feed.

editable_cols.description: Logical fields exposed in the correction editor. Keyed by stable logical field id. Each field maps to one or more physical columns.

active.description: Soft-delete flag. false = entry is deactivated and not surfaced to correction editors.
